_why: Every place in this repository where a fetch from a public registry is followed by executing what came back, with the reason it is allowed. tools/gates/fetch-exec.mjs fails when an occurrence is in neither this file nor a safe class, and when a row here outlives the command it allowed. Written 2026-11-09 by Ursa's security seat, run 13, after finding F113's class on the surface no code sweep reaches.
_keys: A row is keyed on `path` plus the exact `command` text, and NEVER on a line number. A line number drifts whenever anything above it is edited, so a gate keyed on one becomes a thing seats re-baseline instead of read. The command text changes only when the command changes, which is exactly when the row should be looked at again.
_kinds: `allowed` is not an exposure: the fetch cannot reach an unknown package, or the text is not a command anything runs. `owner-reserved-finding` IS an exposure, in a path no seat here may edit, and it must name a docs/ideas.md heading that exists. The gate exits 2 when every remaining finding is of that kind, which is the exit code tools/prompt-slots.mjs lacks and is registered red-on-main for lacking.

HQ's exo-centralizer seat found and repaired the same shape upstream on 2026-11-09.
